title: ever REYA|Cold Shoulder High Slit Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This floor length wedding guest dress highlights the shoulders and collarbone with its cold shoulder design. The fitted bodice defines the waist, while the front slit adds graceful movement and shows off the legs with an elegant touch. A lovely choice for weddings, garden parties, evening celebrations, and other special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric: he garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
